assumptions: Pre-launch: no LinkedIn Ads account has been created yet, so no account_refs or live data source exist.

No regulated advertising category applies to a B2B growth-agency service offer.
Geography is limited to the United States for this initial campaign; not yet confirmed as final.

retention.purpose: Retain the setup and brand profile as reference for planning Apex Standard's LinkedIn brand-awareness campaign; delete after 12 months or upon account closure, whichever is first.
